status: Both first-r9-enemy and first-r9-player independent visual review PASS, accepted by main-thread inspection; final runtime/package/deployment evidence recorded separately. R8 timing and art are preserved.

timing.note: Cloud/fold/shadow clock, fog and early .035..0.18 propagation stay at r8 behavior; new beam angles use whole-card elapsed independently.

beamMotion.clock: Whole-card _State.z, continuous through BeginDice; atan(baseSlope*aspect)+radians(amplitude)*sin(2*pi*t/3.6+phase), converted with tan(angle)/aspect
beamMotion.facing: Host caches (self.faction==Player) XOR (stage!=null && AllyFormationDirection==LEFT); absent stage uses RIGHT. Only effect UV is mirrored; camera source, hit positions, actor bounds and HUD remain screen-space.

cloudPlate.sourceSplitReason: Approved art left lower billow crosses U=.50. U=.54..56 is genuinely clear; sample banks there without cutting authored silhouette or modifying the PNG.
cloudPlate.use: Two disconnected asymmetrical cloud banks. RGB is authored color/volume, A is coverage. Sun and rays are shader-only. Main thread owns image generation and prompt provenance.
cloudPlate.import: 8-bit RGBA color, sRGB=true, FromInput alpha, Clamp, Bilinear, no mipmaps, uncompressed RGBA32, NPOT unchanged, maximum 2048

mist.provenance: Repository-authored read-only atlas reused for this VFX implementation; original deterministic numpy/Pillow fields per round2/manifest.json
mist.use: Low foreground fog only. Read-only original, byte-identical independent Unity import; A is density/lifetime, R/G/B only lighting; interpolated middle frames 5..8
mist.import: linear RGBA, no alpha transparency transform, Clamp, Bilinear, no mipmaps, uncompressed, 1024

preview.label: Native Unity proxy battlefield, real repository character sprites, proxy numbers/UI. Not actual combat/HUD acceptance.

historicalDelivery: R5 was accepted/delivered separately; its PASS does not apply to the refinement candidate. See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-07-velia-tide-mist-delivery.md.
